description:
In this compelling episode, Dr. Walsh sheds light on the manipulative tactics of spiritualism, from attempts to alter nature to dubious interactions with the deceased (demons). Highlighting alarming trends like the rapid growth of Wicca among young people and the rise of Eastern religions, the episode culminates with a heartfelt call to action for parents, echoing the wisdom of Proverbs 22:6.
